sloka: रुरून् अपेता अपजयान् दृष्ट्वा शोकम् प्रहास्यसि ।राम तस्य तु शैलस्य महती शोभते गुहा ॥३-७३-३९॥
transliteration: rurūn apetā apajayān dṛṣṭvā śokam prahāsyasi ।rāma tasya tu śailasya mahatī śobhate guhā ॥3-73-39॥

translations.english: O son of the Kakutstha family, there is a beautiful cave in that mountain covered with a slab of stone. It is difficult to enter.
